answer.evidence: Design B-ATT is 0 dB, but measured loss B-ODF (-11.14 dBm) to B-RX (-21.33 dBm) is ~10.2 dB, matching a wrongly fitted 10 dB attenuator. Link line itself is healthy: A-TX +0.93 dBm in spec and B-ODF power gives ~12 dB total loss matching commissioning 12.12 dB at 1550 nm; embedded OTDR normal both ways; B-ODF connector clean. Rx dropped from ~-11.2 to ~-21.2 dBm on 2026-10-19 immediately after 12:22 note 'Attenuator refitted from spares box', with alarms at 13:00.
